summary: Hyundai ABS Funding, LLC, as depositor for Hyundai Auto Receivables Trust 2026-D, filed an 8-K under Items 8.01 and 9.01 to furnish legality and tax opinions from Mayer Brown LLP (Exhibits 5.1 and 8.1) tied to the issuance of Class A-1, A-2-A and A-2-B auto loan asset-backed notes described in a November 3, 2026 prospectus. No deal terms, prices, stakes or board actions are stated. This is a routine ABS shelf takedown closing, not a special situation; watch only for standard note issuance mechanics and any later ratings or performance updates.
